## Description

Solves high-dimensional Black-Scholes-Barenblatt partial differential equations using the Deep Galerkin Method (DGM) neural network architecture to price multi-asset basket options.

## Where it may fit

Exotic basket options pricing, high-dimensional derivative risk management, non-linear volatility smile extrapolation.

## Vehicles

Derivatives Market Makers, Exotic Options Desks, Structured Product Desks.

## Required data

Basket constituent spot prices, asset cross-correlations, strike prices, implied volatility matrices.

## Caveats

Requires high-performance GPU sampling of spatio-temporal domain boundaries to enforce differential operator loss.
